AboutPage.title: About BILLIANT
AboutPage.subtitle: We're on a mission to make quality healthcare accessible, affordable, and available to everyone through verified medical professionals.
AboutPage.missionText1: To simplify healthcare by building a comprehensive digital platform that connects patients with qualified medical professionals, hospitals, laboratories, pharmacies, and healthcare providers, enabling faster diagnosis, easier access to treatment, and better patient outcomes.
AboutPage.missionText2: We maintain the highest standards of medical quality, privacy, and trust while leveraging technology to eliminate unnecessary delays and improve healthcare delivery.
AboutPage.visionText: To become the world's most trusted digital healthcare ecosystem, making quality medical care accessible, affordable, and available to everyone through a network of licensed healthcare professionals and connected medical institutions.
AboutPage.philosophyTitle: Technology should connect patients with doctors—not replace doctors.
AboutPage.philosophyText: Every medical decision on BILLIANT is made by qualified healthcare professionals. Technology serves to organize, accelerate, and simplify the healthcare journey, ensuring patients receive timely access to expert care while preserving the essential role of human medical judgment.
